description: Face-up playing cards on office-3's overhead wide camera (1920x1080). Two-colour standard-index decks (red- and blue-backed; the two decks have different court-card art). Card bodies: the gigarepo ept-faceup-v5 YOLO11n-OBB detector, unchanged weights (zero-shot on this deck), stored as fp16. Identity: CardNetFast trained here on office-3 OFC/stud footage (cls-v3).

detector.letterbox: area resize of frameCrop by min(1024/w, 480/h) (~0.575), grey 114 padding
detector.output: (6, N): cx, cy, w, h, conf, angle radians

fallbackClassifier.note: cls-v5a: cls-v3 fine-tuned (scripts/ft_cls.py) on v4b's whole-view crops plus 3,959 eye-labelled crops of the jumbo-index PokerStars deck (n1532 16:25-16:37 EST). Read only for crops where cls-v3's best card is < below or none is on top; same gate after that.

classifier.note: cls-f1: cls-v3 fine-tuned (scripts/ft_fact.py) with a factorized head, rank (13 + none) x suit (4); exports log p(52 codes + none). Names jumbo cards whose rank-suit pair was never in its training crops from ranks and suits seen elsewhere.

deckGate.note: deck-v1 (scripts/train_deck.py): cls-v3 convs with a classic / jumbo / none head, trained on whole-hand deck labels (n1532 jumbo hands 3225-3494 and 3746-3937 s, classic hands 2720-3225 and 3494-3746 s, old sessions' v4b crops). A crop whose p(jumbo) >= jumbo in both turns is read by classifier instead of cls-v3; other crops keep cls-v3 and the fallback rule.

handStateNote: OfcHandState parameters (video). stillKeep 0.6: a named card whose box is lost stays while >= 60 % of its 4x-downscaled footprint is unchanged since its last box (README). strip* / corner*: in a jumbo-deck hand the corner reader names a slot the card reader left unnamed after cornerPairVotes views whose two index corners agree, or stripMinViews views whose mean corner read is >= stripProbability (margin stripMargin, stripAgree of views), and only if the card reader's median agrees at >= cornerMedian and no slot has held that name this hand (README). No masked strip reader is shipped. 2026-11-25: oneVoteViews 6 (one gate pass + median of the last 6 views at the median gate), cornerHeldMargin (held cards' indices do not compete in a strip read), stripOwnHeld (a slot may take back its own earlier name), stripHiddenStill (corner names on hidden slots only while the footprint is unchanged), noneHide 0.5 (unread none-like hidden slots are not objects), ghostGrace (unnamed ghosts of a named overlapping card get no long grace) (README). Round 6 (2026-11-25): feltHide 'sticky' (a slot whose centre showed bare felt reports nothing until its own name is read whole again) (README). Round 7: turnBan 2 / turnShare 0.25 (a name the turned-crop + pip-count check contradicted on >= 2 gate passes and >= 25 % of them is barred from the slot; see turnVeto), pipMedian 0.7 (a number card whose >= pipVotes gate passes count its own rank of pips on >= pipAgree of them is held at median 0.7 instead of 0.8) (README).

cornerReader.patch: 4 corners of the 64x96 classifier crop, 36x36, each turned so that corner sits top-left (corner_patches)
cornerReader.output: log p of 52 codes + none per corner: rank (13 + none) from contrast-normalized luma x suit (4) from colour
cornerReader.note: corner5: jumbo-index deck only (read in hands where >= jumboShare of crops pass the deck gate). Trained (scripts/corner/) on corner patches of the eye-labelled whole jumbo crops of the two training hands (n1532 3225-3494 and 3746-3937 s), positives cleaned by 4-fold cross-validation by slot, plus rank/suit recombination and synthetic rank glyphs drawn in system fonts. A slot the card reader leaves unnamed is named from corners only when the card reader's median over its last 20 views puts the same card on top at >= cornerMedian (README).

turnVeto.note: Round 7 (README): a gate pass on a near-square box (width >= aspect x height, a sideways card squashed into the upright crop) whose crop turned a quarter reads another number card at >= probability, with the pip count (pip_count) equal to that card's rank, is not a vote; handState.turnBan such views (and >= turnShare of the name's gate passes) bar that name from the slot.
